2609.17065.title: Beyond "ChatGPT Can Make Mistakes": Designing Interventions to Support Metacognitive Monitoring in AI-Assisted Work
2609.17065.paper_summary: AI assistance places a metacognitive demand on users, who must judge their own competence and the system's. Yet designers lack comparative evidence on which interventions to choose, where to place them, and how to tell whether they worked. We elicited 30 interventions from 11 experts and, with prior work, organized them into a design space of time (when an intervention acts), level (whose competence is judged), and source (who supplies the monitoring cue). A between-subjects experiment (N = 917; 12 planning-and-organizing problems) compared a per-task reliability card, contrasting replies, pause points, and post-problem reflection against a baseline LLM assistant. Reliability cards and contrasting replies reduced estimation error and overconfidence and increased aggregate confidence discrimination. No task-performance improvement or average within-item discrimination gain was established. We contribute a shared vocabulary, a design space, and evidence that measured monitoring and task performance are separable design targets.
2609.17065.paper_summary_zh: AI 輔助對使用者提出了元認知的要求，使用者必須評估自己的能力和系統的能力。然而，設計者缺乏比較證據來選擇哪些干預措施、將其放置在哪裡以及如何判斷它們是否有效。我們從 11 位專家那裡引出了 30 項干預措施，並與先前的工作一起，將它們組織成一個設計空間，包括時間（干預何時發生）、層級（誰的能力被評估）和來源（誰提供監控提示）。一項跨受試者實驗（N = 917；12 個計劃與組織問題）比較了一個每任務可靠性卡，對比回應、暫停點和問題後反思，與基線 LLM 輔助進行比較。可靠性卡和對比回應減少了估計誤差和過度自信，並增加了整體信心的區分。未建立任務表現改善或平均項目內區分增益。我們貢獻了一個共享詞彙、一個設計空間，以及證據表明測量監控和任務表現是可分的設計目標。
2609.17065.author: Manuel A. D. Santos et.al.
2609.17065.authors: Manuel A. D. Santos, Paul Thiesse, Steeven Villa, Daniela Fernandes, Albrecht Schmidt, Verena Distler, Robin Welsch
